FROM usage_ledger 
WHERE usage_ledger.learner_id = :learner_id_1::VARCHAR AND usage_ledger.created_at >= :created_at_1::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND purpose IN ('assistant','document') AND usage_ledger.purpose IN (:purpose_1_1::VARCHAR, :purpose_1_2::VARCHAR) ORDER BY usage_ledger.id
